html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · July 4, 2022

On Jul 1, 2022, marketing automation vendor Jingsuo Tech (径硕科技) (founded 2016) closed a ¥50M Series A+ led by Linear Capital, with Xingong following — 2nd disclosed round (A Jun’21) — for team and GTM. WeChat-centric MA for FMCG, apparel, travel, property, luxury; B2B MA push since 2020. Five modules: MA journeys, sales automation, JINGTrack multi-channel behavior, JINGConnect MA/SFA↔CRM, CDP for cross-system portraits.

— END —
